We closed the largest pre-seed round ever raised in Italy (€4.7M) , backed by some of the sharpest entrepreneurs in tech. Italy is known as the land of red tape. That red tape is one of the acknowledged reasons the Italian economy is stuck. Jet's mission? Erase bureaucracy from Italian firms . What is bureaucracy, exactly? Hours spent decoding regulations, filling in forms, waiting for approvals and fixing the inevitable human errors. Jet is the answer: a single platform that simplifies and automates the entire admin side of an Italian company. It's obvious that the future can't stay this slow and clunky: with Jet we're pulling that future forward, and we have a real shot at becoming the default operative system of Italian companies. We hate bureaucracy: let's go kill it. What you'll do Explore and optimise paid channels. You'll run and improve campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn and new paid channels. You’ll manage campaigns and creatives to drive CAC down. Relentless automation . The old ways of running paid campaigns aren't enough anymore. You'll be on the front line of automating your own work and building new tools to make it more efficient. Optimise the acquisition funnel . Landing pages, follow-ups, retargeting: your scope doesn't stop at capturing leads, but goes all the way to signing deals. What we're looking for At least 2 years of experience in Paid Marketing B2B. You know how to set up rigorous A/B tests and identify what actually works in highly complex environments. An impact-driven mindset. You understand how every part of your job affects conversions, pipeline and ARR generated. You spot bottlenecks and problems worth solving without needing constant input. You avoid perfectionism. A taste for hackish solutions. We're not looking for an engineer, but for someone who can move easily across automation tools, different data sources and integrations between systems. It takes curiosity, initiative and the autonomy to explore new technologies and solve technical problems yourself. Your ability to learn fast and adapt to change will be essential to succeeding in this role. Creativity and an eye for copy and design . You've produced creatives and copy that significantly lifted conversions and performance. You don’t just create something that looks nice: you know how to communicate our brand and the product's value to create actual conversions. What we offer €45,000 to €60,000 gross annual salary. Real impact. We're a startup, so everyone makes an essential contribution to Jet's growth. Our revenues will be a direct result of your work, and you'll have a major impact on the company's bottom line. Ownership . We expect you to go from idea to execution on your own. You own the final output. You'll be responsible for building our acquisition machines from zero to hundreds of thousands of clients. Start-up environment. Not just any startup, but a well-funded one packed with talent. In 6 months you'll see and learn things that elsewhere might take years, with a very high level of responsibility and involvement. Hybrid work. Our office is in Milan and we do expect you in, but with flexibility. We're not sticklers - we run on common sense. We’re open to discuss fully-remote work. About Us: Let’s bring the Italian soul of chocolate to life! Since 1878, at Venchi we have celebrated chocolate in all its forms: from the authentic taste of our cocoa origins to the art of gelato. Today, we are a team of over 1,700 people across more than 200 stores worldwide, united by the same passion for quality and Italian excellence. At the heart of this journey are our values: Taste, Truth, Ingenuity, and Togetherness. They mean creating authentic experiences with care and precision; acting with transparency and responsibility; turning curiosity into impact through creativity and innovation; growing together by building trust and collaboration every day. Joining Venchi means embarking on an endless journey where tradition meets innovation, bringing quality, well-being, and the joy of positive indulgence around the world. Your Mission : We are looking for a highly motivated Wholesale Marketing Manager to join our HQ based in Milan! Reporting to the Global Senior Trade Marketing Manager, you will play a crucial role in enhancing our brand presence in the Wholesale and Travel Retail channels, with a global scope. This role will serve as a key hub in coordinating and executing brand activations and initiatives, being the main point of contact for the Wholesale Team for channel marketing needs. Key Responsibilities : Design and implement a proper channel marketing strategy tailored to wholesale sub-channels (Key Accounts, Distributors, Travel Retail, Franchising, Traditional) to increase sales, product visibility, market share. Scout, manage and collaborate with external agencies to design dedicated displays and tools for Wholesale and Travel Retail, ensuring alignment with brand identity. Own the Wholesale Catalogue project multi-functional creation and lead the process of sharing with Customers, in alignment with Wholesale Team. Adapt visual merchandising guidelines based on product assortments, working closely with Marketing and Sales Teams to ensure consistency, through planogram management for key accounts and prioritary activations. Supervise and project-manage the most relevant fairs and events for the Wholesale and Travel Retail business, to ensure global consistency in Venchi’s presence. Oversee the execution of pop-ups and special activations, aimed to drive sales and visibility in high traffic locations. Analyze Wholesale channel performance, identify opportunities for growth, and optimize channel-specific marketing tactics. Create a comprehensive activation plan, aligned with Global Marketing guidelines, incorporating in-store experiences and promotional guidelines. Continuously monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging technologies to identify new opportunities and maintain the brand’s competitive edge in Wholesale and Travel Retail channels. The Ideal Candidate : Minimum 5 years of experience in Trade Marketing, with a proven track record in channel marketing management, and creating best practices for Wholesale channels. Strong expertise in Wholesale channels and in-depth understanding of their unique dynamics. Effective communicator, skilled at engaging stakeholders at all levels to clearly articulate Venchi's strategic vision. Commercially astute, with the ability to assess market trends, identify trade opportunities, and translate insights into actionable plans. Project management driven and experienced in collaborating with external agencies to achieve business goals. Based in Milan and experienced in working on a Global scale. Fluent in English, with additional language skills considered an advantage. … and of course a chocolate and gelato lover! What We Offer: Celebrate Success: Annual results-based bonus, with the option to convert it into welfare benefits. Flexibility and Balance: Benefit from flexible working hours and hybrid work options. Global Vision, Local Flavour: Join a passionate, creative team where innovation thrives. From our global HQ in the heart of the city, near our iconic stores, help bring the Venchi experience to life. Together, we craft excellence, from sourcing premium ingredients to delivering joyful moments worldwide. Exclusive Sweet Benefits: Enjoy a 30% discount in-store and 40% off our e-commerce platform. Plus, you will receive special gifts packed with Venchi’s finest chocolate. Benefit from tickets restaurant, access to two comprehensive welfare platforms, and additional private health insurance to enhance your personal well-being. Join us at Venchi and help us bringing the Italian way of life and delicious flavours to every corner of the world! We look forward to hearing from you!
